summary: Morgan County, TN 60' Aermotor tower first on Walden Mountain near Harriman; sold by the state in 1994, restored by private owners by 1998, now on Windswept Farm; NHLR-registered 1999.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing by Tennessee Landforms; the Register does not describe current condition
facts.agency: Craig Davidson (administrator per NHLR); Tennessee Division of Forestry until its 1994 sale

access.note: On Windswept Farm; the Register credits new private owners with the restoration; no public access found

events.note: Tennessee Forestry Division sold the tower; the Register says it originally stood on Walden Mountain near Harriman
New private owners completed reconstruction and restoration on Windswept Farm
Registered March 17, 1999 as US 312, TN 5; nominated by Rob Norwood

notes_for_editor: Register says the tower originally stood on Walden Mountain near Harriman; a WebSearch named Walden Ridge as the nearby feature, unconfirmed, so the story keeps the Register's wording. Elevation conflict: Register gives 958 ft for the farm site, Tennessee Landforms lists 1,506 ft for Windswept; not resolved, flagged in story. No build year found in any page read. Status standing rests on the Tennessee Landforms list alone. Brief access 'unknown' is now private per the Register's farm and owner wording. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story now says the Register credits new private owners, not that the farm is private, because the sources do not state that.
